description: xAI Grok routing defaults for the Grok Bot host. Grok 4.3 handles economical work; Grok 4.6 handles demanding architecture, build, and review work. Live spawn is Grok Bot Task/executor (see GROK.md). grok-build-0.1 remains exec-only.

cheap.notes: Fast, low-cost surveys and routine transformations. 4.3 is the cheaper production rung ($1.25/$2.50 per 1M under 200k).

standard.notes: Utility roles and straightforward prompt/document work.

strong.notes: Default for architecture, critique, backend, and frontend first pass. xAI's current flagship for code and agents.

frontier.notes: Final gates, subtle design/code risk, or high-stakes reviews. Same model as strong; raise effort and treat as escalation, not a first-pass default.

escalated.notes: Repeated failure, hard adjudication, or explicit human request. No separate super-flagship ID as of 2026-08-23; escalate via posture, not a different slug.
